content.text: Flip is a deadpooled company based in El Segundo (United States), founded in 2019 by Noor Agha and Jonathan Ellman. It operates as an App-based video commerce platform for buying and selling multi-category products. Flip has raised $236M in funding from investors like Streamlined Ventures, TLV Partners and WestCap, with last known valuation of $1.05B. The company has 199 active competitors, including 42 funded and 14 that have exited. Its top competitors include companies like Tise, Mushroom Street and Reebonz.
